title: Veritas: A Verifier Generation Harness for Agent Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.13336v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The effectiveness of a self-improving system relies heavily on the quality of its verifier, which judges the outcome of each improvement round. However, the verifiers of most tasks are written by hand, which is expensive and does not scale to tasks that come without one. We propose Veritas, a harness that generates verifiers automatically. Unlike general-purpose agent harnesses, Veritas adds three mechanisms for verifier generation: an evidence header stating what the verifier will observe, a library of domain rules that tasks leave unstated, and authoring principles, partly refined by a self-improvement loop. We evaluate on six benchmarks: four scored by execution, whose official verifiers we first certify, and two that compare pairs of responses. translated_title: Veritas：面向智能体任务的验证器生成框架
translated_abstract: 自我改进系统的有效性在很大程度上取决于其验证器的质量，验证器负责评判每一轮改进的结果。然而，大多数任务的验证器都是手工编写的，这不仅成本高昂，而且无法扩展到那些没有现成验证器的任务。我们提出了 Veritas，一个能够自动生成验证器的框架。与通用的智能体框架不同，Veritas 为验证器生成增加了三种机制：声明验证器将观察内容的证据头、包含任务中未明说的领域规则的规则库，以及部分通过自我改进循环得以完善的编写原则。我们在六个基准上进行了评估：其中四个由执行结果评分（我们首先对其官方验证器进行了认证），另外两个则对成对的回答进行比较。在固定模型的情况下，在全部四个执行评分基准上，Veritas 生成的验证器与官方判定结果的一致性均优于其他七个框架生成的验证器。在两个成对比较基准上（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: Veritas 是一个自动生成智能体任务验证器的框架，通过引入证据头、领域规则库和编写原则三种机制，使其生成的验证器与官方判定结果的一致性在多个基准上超越其他七个框架。
en_tdlr: Veritas is a harness that automatically generates verifiers for agent tasks using three mechanisms—an evidence header, a domain-rule library, and authoring principles—and its generated verifiers agree better with official verdicts than those of seven other harnesses.
